title: Magic Water Sort: Color Puzzle
seo_title: Magic Water Sort — Free Color Bottle Sorting Game Online
meta_desc: Play Magic Water Sort free online. Pour water between bottles until each bottle holds a single color across hundreds of relaxing sort puzzle levels.
desc: Magic Water Sort fills dozens of bottles with mixed colors and asks you to un-mix them. Tap to pour, plan the order, and leave every bottle holding exactly one color. Later levels add more bottles, deeper stacks and trickier color combinations.
howto: Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another to pour.
Pours are only allowed onto a matching top color or into an empty bottle.
A bottle is done when it contains a single color and is full.
Clear every bottle to finish the level.
Work through hundreds of levels that grow steadily harder.
tips: Count how many units of each color exist before your first pour.
Never fill your last empty bottle unless the pour frees a stuck color.
Start with colors that already have the most units grouped together.
